subject: Post-call recap + proposal: rotating triple-band demo windows (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next step: technical deep dive / rotating demo windows

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment before the technical deep dive: 

- Primary goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency customer-facing features (text generation + embeddings) across EU and US regions.
- Data sensitivity: PHI-lite; want private VPC option for auditability.
- Traffic profile: spiky bursts around product launches; need predictable throughput and autoscaling.
- Success criteria for PoC: median 95th-pct latency < 350ms for 512-token sequences in US region, and stable KV cache hit > 60% for repeated user prompts.

Next step: schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep dive with your infra/eng team and our serving/runtime engineers. To make scheduling fair across your global teams we wanted to propose a rotating triple-band schedule (US / EU / APAC-friendly windows) so the same Redwood engineers cover overlapping hands-on sessions without burning out.

I attached the discovery notes and a draft mutual action plan. Below are 3 proposed bands (we included conversions):

- Band A (US-friendly): 11:00–12:15 PT — 19:00–20:15 CET — 02:00–03:15 SGT (next day)
- Band B (EU-friendly): 16:00–17:15 PT — 00:00–01:15 CET (next day) — 07:00–08:15 SGT (next day)
- Band C (APAC-friendly): 20:30–21:45 PT — 04:30–05:45 CET (next day) — 11:30–12:45 SGT (next day)

Proposal: run the first deep dive in Band A this coming week, then alternate bands for follow-ups so Clearline eng has at least one session per band during the PoC (helps on-call rotations). Can you confirm which of these bands works better for Daniel + the infra team?

Action items for Marta: please share 2–3 preferred time slots inside one band (we’ll take care of the timezone math). I can also share a calendar poll if you prefer.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
